test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the cube that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/642fe3b173f8e6b2798d6114446f9571f370986bb07e856dffbd4841c50327ee.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8125ac2ab00f54bcb3f068688319b5325baf7f1c4d9e2fac6cebab2b7a9a1ded.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a46d7d22e47776a169922188483ed7a0def8aafe8d08530ba4ed8db6eb1abb9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c84f454dcef769b1897eb8f5b46996760f4fdcf28e54e65ce82552913861313.png] 

**As the alternate position becomes opposite to each other and remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.**

So, the opposite face are:

 
• 1 ⇔ 4
 
• 2 ⇔ 6
 
• 3 ⇔ 5

Now we consider the given options:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e59e107ec6a46e5fad96c7272acf48263d68751298e51b6d620e47203493170e.png] Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 3 is opposite to 5)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e3a633627f227603b12a3add906de9f3b87f6623af0c989447fdc59453620c9.png] Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 4 is opposite to 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b05002d1abfdd57485fa508cfbf7fc75f5b9f1668ae8ad9530631c81c86730d5.png] Can be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 2,4,5 are one of the number of each opposite pairs.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cde9aba90282d4740aa06c38a03b89e187092f2c45c5b98928561633f5d95ac.png] Can be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 1,5,6 are one of the number of each opposite pairs.)

So, **only C and D will be formed.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
